definition: The links between accelerators: NVLink/NVSwitch within a node, InfiniBand or RoCE across nodes.
details: The links between accelerators: NVLink/NVSwitch within a node, InfiniBand or RoCE across nodes. Parallelism strategies are chosen around interconnect bandwidth, and cluster networking is where large-training projects quietly succeed or fail.

explainer.lead: Interconnect refers to the links between accelerators: NVLink/NVSwitch inside a node and InfiniBand or RoCE across nodes. It matters because parallelism strategies are chosen around interconnect bandwidth, and cluster networking is where large-training projects quietly succeed or fail.

tiers.eli5: It is the plumbing between chips: fast pipes inside one machine and longer pipes between machines, and the whole job slows down if the pipes are too narrow.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers pick parallelism strategies to fit available interconnect bandwidth and treat cluster networking as a first-order design constraint. A pitfall is under-provisioning inter-node links, so communication stalls dominate training time.
tiers.paperLevel: Interconnect covers NVLink/NVSwitch within a node and InfiniBand or RoCE across nodes; parallelism strategies are selected around interconnect bandwidth.

explainer.example: A training run that fits within one node uses NVLink for fast gradient exchange, while scaling across nodes shifts the bottleneck to InfiniBand bandwidth between machines.
